demo.code:
# List Robinhood tokens where this wallet is fee beneficiary
curl "https://api.bankr.bot/public/doppler/beneficiary-fees/0xYourWallet"

# Pay Me Dividends filtered proxy (use Railway URL if custom domain TLS pending)
curl "https://paymedividends-production.up.railway.app/v1/bankr/beneficiary-fees/0xYourWallet"

# Deep link — existing token, stock-paired pool only\open "https://app.paymedividends.xyz/#test-lab?token=0x80db362eab104ec378e19d0a3dcd5e84bafd4ba3"

setup: User must be the current Bankr fee beneficiary on a Robinhood Chain stock-paired token (≥95% share).
Connect wallet on Robinhood Chain (4663) or use Bankr wallet with Robinhood support.
Router must use SwapToSettlement policy so meme fees convert to paired RWA (keeper handles swaps — not the bot).
For new tokens, use app.paymedividends.xyz instead — this skill is for existing tokens only.
